# A waiting room without a clock

The clinic removed the wall clock during repainting and hasn't replaced it. Mum checked her phone every few minutes. We knew the appointment time but not whether the queue was moving. A receptionist saying that the doctor was running late helped more than another reminder message. Write down the actual sequence in [[Care arrangements]] before compressing it into an opinion about hospital efficiency.
